title: Floral Jersey Creamer Potatoes
description: A gluten-free side dish that combines the natural sweetness of potatoes with the delicate flavor of floral notes. This recipe is easy to prepare and yields a delicious result.
instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes, then chop them into 1-inch cubes.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with salt.
Roast the potatoes in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, heat the Jersey cream over medium heat.
Add the floral honey to the cream and stir until dissolved.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and toss them with the cream mixture.
Return the potatoes to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
